summary: Room reset callers may reconcile an evidence-projected canonical item/reset key to an explicit target quantity without deleting excess instances.
rules: room identity, reset key, canonical item id, and target quantity are mandatory authoritative inputs
existing matching room instances retain identity
only target deficits create new runtime identities
repeated reconciliation at target is idempotent
existing quantity above target fails atomically rather than silently deleting world state
stack creation obeys projected maximum_stack and destination reconciliation
assumptions: World Runtime supplies the native reset schedule and target quantity.
Classic reset keys remain inactive until projected from authoritative data.
safe_fallback: Reject missing/invalid reset identity and reject excess-state removal.
runtime_impact: Adds deterministic room item reset reconciliation primitive.
world_state_impact: Room item instances and reset metadata persist through the existing item world repository.
